title: VCAP Negotiation Request
description: Sent by the requester to initiate a service request. Phase 1 of the VCAP protocol.

message_type.description: Discriminator for the VCAP message type.

negotiation_id.description: Unique identifier for this negotiation, generated by the marketplace.

requester.description: The agent or human initiating the service request.

agent_id.description: URI or UUID identifying the requester agent.

provider.description: The agent that will perform the requested work.

agent_id.description: URI or UUID identifying the provider agent.

request.description: Details of the service being requested.

service_type.description: Free-form string or taxonomy value describing the type of service.

description.description: Human-readable description of the work to be done.

budget_amount.description: Maximum budget in decimal currency units.

requirements.description: OPTIONAL implementation-specific requirements for the service.

verification_hints.description: OPTIONAL hints to guide the verification engine.

url.description: URL of the deliverable to verify.

selector.description: CSS selector or JSONPath to extract specific content.

expected_content.description: Substring or pattern that must appear in the deliverable (case-insensitive).

fingerprint_delta.description: If true, verify that the page content has changed from a prior known state.

custom.description: Verifier-specific parameters (e.g., LLM rubric, API schema).
